text: Users can build a custom MCP client to integrate their own app, agent, or bot with a Capacities space
quote: Build your own app, agent, or bot and integrate it with a Capacities space by implementing a custom MCP client using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) open standard.

text: The API uses OAuth2 Bearer token authentication
quote: The Capacities API uses Bearer authentication (token-based authentication, OAuth 2.0 RFC 6750).

text: Chat Connectors let external AI chat apps like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Le Chat connect to a Capacities space
quote: Chat Connectors let you connect AI chat apps, like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Le Chat, to your Capacities space.

text: AI can auto-fill custom object properties using the model's own knowledge
quote: AI Property Auto-Fill: Rather than manually filling in the properties of your custom objects, you can rely on the AI model's knowledge to auto-fill them for you.

text: All backlinks to an object are grouped in a dedicated Backlinks section
quote: Backlinks help you see where an object is referenced across your space.

text: Individual blocks can be linked/embedded and stay synced across pages (block references)
quote: Capacities lets you link to individual blocks inside of an object, and reference them in other pages. We call this concept block-based linking or just block references.

text: Embedded blocks are identical copies whose edits propagate everywhere they're used
quote: An embedded block is identical to the original. This means that any edits will occur in all places where this block is used.

text: Graph view visualizes links between notes as a local neighbourhood graph
quote: Graph view shows how one object connects to others. Each link between notes becomes a line in the graph, so you can see the local neighbourhood around the note you have open.

text: A Day view aggregates all content and references linked to that date
quote: The "Day" view incorporates all available information for that day, such as content created on that day or links to a certain time.

text: Daily notes are uniquely linked to a specific day for quick capture
quote: A daily note is a note that is uniquely linked to one day. It often serves as a quick and simple way to write down ideas or things to remember as they occur throughout the day.

text: Templates can prefill properties and blocks when creating new objects
quote: Templates allow you to prefill the content of an object- you can prefill properties and blocks in your objects.

text: Search works offline on all devices and tolerates inexact wording
quote: Search in Capacities is great for navigation, finding, and connecting your content. It works offline on all devices, giving you quick search results every time.

text: Automatic exports can be scheduled on a recurring basis
quote: You can schedule automatic exports by going to Settings > Full Export > Automated Full Export > Add Schedule.

text: Mobile app lets users search and capture content on the go as a companion to desktop
quote: The mobile app is a companion to desktop for day-to-day work in your space: search and capture on the go.

text: App is offline-first and syncs changes automatically once back online
quote: Capacities is an offline-first application. You can work offline and your changes will get synchronized as soon as you're back online.

text: Migration guide supports curating structure before exporting from Notion
quote: Migrate from Notion by curating structure before export.

text: Any imported image becomes a reusable image object across the space
quote: Any image you input into Capacities becomes an image object, that can be reused anywhere in your space.

text: AI features are opt-in; no data is shared with third-party AI services unless activated
quote: AI features in Capacities are fully opt-in. If you do not activate AI, no data from your spaces is shared with any third-party AI services.

text: Users can start AI chats and pass blocks or notes as context
quote: AI Chats: Start a chat with AI from Explore, or with a keyboard shortcut. You can pass blocks or notes as context.

text: AI can analyze images to extract title, description, OCR text, color palette, and category
quote: AI Image Analysis: Analyze any image with one click. The AI extracts a title, description, text (OCR, including handwritten text), a color palette, and a category.

text: Selected content can be exported as Markdown + CSV for migration purposes
quote: Export only the selected content you intend to migrate. Use Markdown + CSV as your default format for this flow.

text: Object types can be automatically created by the app or defined manually as custom types
quote: Object types are either created automatically by Capacities, or you can create them yourself.

text: Recommended workflow is to define core object types (People, Projects, Meetings) with properties early
quote: Capacities is object-type-first. Define key object types early (`People`, `Projects`, `Meetings`, etc.) and add core properties.

text: Feature set includes task management, AI assistant, calendar integrations, smart queries, and task actions
quote: Task management, AI assistant, Calendar integrations, Smart queries, Task actions

text: Notes can be shared with others as view-only access
quote: Grant others view-only access to notes

text: Exports convert properties to front matter and collections to CSV files for reuse in other tools
quote: All your properties are transformed into front matter values, all collections are stored as CSV files, making it easy to reuse your content in other apps or work with it programmatically.

text: Exports are designed to be both human-readable and machine-readable
quote: Exports from Capacities are fully human- and machine-readable at the same time.

text: A REST API allows accessing, creating, and manipulating content programmatically
quote: The Capacities API is a REST API that allows you access, create and manipulate your content.

text: Users can choose to download all media or only required media files locally
quote: You can select whether you want to download media files to your device. You have two options: Everything... Required only.

text: Unlimited spaces, objects, and blocks are supported
quote: Unlimited spaces, objects, and blocks
